decided_by: the owner, in his words: genesis first of the 39
what_this_is: the order the door files the served books in. The chain's own sequence is alphabetical, because that is how the corpus lane sealed the Tanakh, and a door that reads it as it stands files Amos before Genesis. This record names a reading order instead. It is a display order and not a claim about the text: a book keeps every count and record it had wherever it stands, and a book the record does not name keeps the chain's order after the named ones.

traditions.printed: the order of the printed Hebrew Bible: the Torah; the Former Prophets; the Latter Prophets with the Twelve in their own order; the Writings with Psalms first, the five scrolls in the order of the festivals, and Chronicles last.
traditions.codex: the order of the Aleppo and Leningrad codices, which differs only in the Writings: Chronicles first, then Psalms, Job, Proverbs, Ruth, Song of Songs, Ecclesiastes, Lamentations, Esther, Daniel, Ezra and Nehemiah. Not in force; recorded so the choice is visible.

awaits: the corpus lane's own order ledger, if one is delivered; until then this is the serving lane's authored order on the owner's word
